source_explicit: descending trendline is a directional structure
the broken trendline is retested as support
a bullish EasyChart order block overlaps the retest area
the order-block formation extreme supplies structural invalidation
the prior high supplies the single objective
case_inference: the trendline and bullish order block are not two votes; the line supplies S/R role while the order block supplies executable price geometry
FVG and channel are not required for this episode

automation_contract.entry_surface: first reachable active support among the broken line and same-leg bullish footprint
automation_contract.stop: lowest invalidation extreme belonging to the retest response leg
automation_contract.target: first active opposing high or structure; do not skip a sub-1R first objective

source_explicit: a liquidity sweep precedes a bullish order block and FVG
the order-block body and FVG are potential return zones
the full formation extreme is the invalidation area
if price does not return to the planned area there is no entry
case_inference: the order block identifies the response origin and the FVG describes the same displacement; they are not independent confirmation counts
user_override: source examples include split entries and partial exits, but candidate-easychart must select one entry and one full-position target

automation_contract.single_entry_selection: first role-complete reachable zone in the expected retracement path; overlapping zones are one causal cluster
automation_contract.stop: full-position STOP_MARKET beyond the complete formation extreme
automation_contract.target: single first active opposing structure with gross RR >= 1

source_explicit: a large bullish structure around 70.5k defines the main long invalidation
smaller 4h, 6h and 8h bearish order blocks can cause a pullback
12h FVG and daily bullish order block are lower support/value structures
the main long view remains unless the large invalidation is broken
case_inference: local bearish footprints change the local phase to pullback but do not authorize a macro short
scale and structural function dominate recency of an opposite pattern

automation_contract.entry: first macro-consistent response from an active lower support/value structure
automation_contract.stop: macro-consistent trade-leg invalidation, not an arbitrary latest candle
automation_contract.target: first active opposing structure inside the macro objective path

source_explicit: price is outside the lower boundary of a large descending channel
a 4h bullish order block forms while price is outside
the order block is used before full channel reclaim
later channel reentry confirms the trap interpretation
the first meaningful structure inside the channel supplies the target
case_inference: confirmed reclaim and predictive outside-footprint entry are two initiation modes of the same failed-break option, not mutually exclusive definitions
the bullish footprint while outside is the response evidence; the channel supplies location and target geometry

automation_contract.predictive_mode: outside excursion plus opposite sponsored footprint before accepted continuation
automation_contract.confirmed_mode: immediate fakeout or source-shaped W/M trap followed by first retest
automation_contract.accepted_break_preemption: if outside acceptance is established before response, do not arm reversal
automation_contract.stop: outside excursion and footprint formation extreme
automation_contract.target: first active internal channel or opposing structure

source_gap_policy.CASE_INFERENCE: implement as a named hypothesis and test against source cases before market performance
source_gap_policy.EXTERNAL_ADAPTATION: may solve a programming ambiguity but cannot silently replace the source strategy
source_gap_policy.UNRESOLVED: no trade and retain an audit reason
